title: Complete beginner, cutting, gym, 4 days

expectations.assert: experience.trainingKnowledge == complete_beginner; trainedBefore='never' hard-forces the class regardless of other signals
BMR via Mifflin-St Jeor male (+5); TDEE = round(bmr × min(1.9, 1.2 + 4×0.025)); calories = TDEE − 400, floored at 1500
macros: protein = round(1.8 × 86 kg); fat = round(0.27 × kcal / 9); carbs = remainder floored at 0
sets 3 compound / 3 isolation (beginner tier); cut scheme: compound 8–12 reps rest 90s, isolation 12–15 rest 60s
5 exercises/session (beginner base 5, 60 min delta 0); machine-priority ordering for beginner tier
no exercise with level 'advanced' in the plan
step target derived from 4200 baseline plus a modest labeled increment — NOT a flat 10000
initial plan scenario; no review period
plan warnings include conservativeStartApplied only if conservative-start triggers; no jargon-level codes for beginners
checkpoint 1 = pass; calories above male floor 1500

notes: Baseline happy path. Step-target expectation is the [CTO-QAE-001] §14 supersession of the legacy flat 10k default; increment magnitude blocked on EVR-007.
